claims.text: The cancellation fee is chargeable only if all four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold, and it is the driver who must carry each one. Limb (b) needs a gps_trace fix inside the TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius at or before the recorded 'arrived' event, and limb (c) needs a continuous in-geofence dwell of at least 300 seconds measured from the first qualifying fix rather than from the tap. The only GPS artifact on the brief, EV-GPS-00213, is MISSING: it has no payload and a weight_multiplier of 0.0, and a MISSING artifact can carry no fact at all, although its absence is itself citable (POL-GEN-02). Limbs (b) and (c) therefore fail as unproven, and where any one of (a) to (d) fails the fee is not chargeable under this clause.

POL-NS-02 deems the driver to have arrived only where the trace holds at least three consecutive fixes, each reporting horizontal accuracy of 25 m or better, inside the arrival radius - 150 m for a TRANSPORT_HUB bay such as Jurong East. There is no qualifying fix here because there is no trace: no in-radius reading exists at any point in the 15 minutes preceding the 17:53:40 cancellation. On the clause as written the driver never arrived, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the $6.00.

The most the surviving artifacts show is the driver's own 'arrived' tap at 17:47:05 and a cancellation 395 seconds later, and that interval is not a dwell. POL-NS-01(c) deliberately runs the waiting clock from GPS entry into the geofence, not from the driver tapping 'arrived', and POL-NS-05 will not let an arrival marker start the clock where the marker cannot be matched to a fix. With no fix to date the geofence entry, the effective dwell is unestablished and cannot be found to meet the 300-second minimum for this zone class.

The rider says she messaged three times and got nothing back. The platform's own surviving record agrees with her on the count - trip_record.chat_message_count is 3 - while the export itself, EV-CHAT-00213, is MISSING at weight 0.0, so the driver's counter that he 'replied to every message she sent' stands on nothing the tribunal can inspect. POL-NS-04's limbs (a) and (b) cannot be run either way on a lost log, and because the artifact can carry no fact for either side the loss cannot be read as the rider failing to coordinate.

POL-NS-04(c) provides in terms that where rider_track is absent, or every fix in it is filtered out for accuracy, the rider-presence test is UNDECIDABLE and neutral - neither satisfied nor failed - and the Judge must record that the test could not be run rather than inferring the rider was elsewhere. The trace carries no rider track because it carries nothing at all, so nothing in evidence places the rider away from the Jurong East bay, and she cannot be fixed with absence.

The facts that decide this case - whether the driver entered the geofence and held it - are carried by no admissible artifact at all: EV-GPS-00213 and EV-CHAT-00213 both sit at weight_multiplier 0.0. Under POL-GEN-02(2) confidence is capped by the weight of the artifacts that carry the deciding fact, which here is zero and far below the 0.70 platform floor, so the escalation floor is engaged and no money order may issue against the rider on this record. The $6.00 is PENDING, neither collected nor refunded, and it must stay on hold rather than being taken.

This is not a first dispute between these two. rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 2, which is exactly the trigger POL-NS-09(c) names - two or more no-show disputes between the same rider and driver in the trailing 90 days. That limb is terminal for the automated pipeline and holds the disputed fee rather than collecting it, so the rider's $6.00 must not be taken while this pair's third round is resolved.

POL-NS-07 pays the driver 80 percent of the fee only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full. It is not satisfied, because the GPS limbs fail as unproven, so there is no verified no-show to compensate and no compensation to fund. The rider should not be charged $6.00 so that $4.80 of it can be passed to a driver whose arrival no admissible artifact establishes.

claims.text: The trip_record for TRP-00213 is complete and unimpaired at weight 1.0, and it records a driver 'arrived' event at 2026-08-11T17:47:05+08:00. POL-NS-01 limb (a) asks only that the trip_record contain a driver arrival event for the trip, and on this record it does.

The same complete trip_record shows the driver terminated the trip at 2026-08-11T17:53:40+08:00 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_UNREACHABLE, which is one of the three codes POL-NS-01 limb (d) recognises. The driver did not select DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, the code that clause treats as the driver's own admission that he could not find the rider.

On the trip_record's own clock the driver was on station from the 17:47:05 arrival event to the 17:53:40 cancellation, an elapsed 395 seconds, and the record's own wait_time_min of 6.6 corroborates it. That is longer than the 300-second minimum dwell the fee schedule fixes for a TRANSPORT_HUB pickup under POL-NS-01 limb (c). Limb (c) prefers to measure that dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, and no trace exists to supply one; the record's own timeline is the only timeline in the bundle, and nothing in it shows a shorter hold.

The GPS trace EV-GPS-00213 is MISSING - weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT - and the admissibility note on the artifact itself records that POL-NS-01 limbs (b) and (c), POL-NS-02, POL-NS-03, POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06 are all undecidable for want of any positional data. Under POL-GEN-02(3) a MISSING artifact carries no fact, so the absence of a trace is not a trace showing the driver elsewhere. POL-NS-02's refund test requires a trace that actually 'contains no qualifying in-radius fix', and there is no such trace here to examine.

The chat log EV-CHAT-00213 is MISSING - weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT - although trip_record.chat_message_count records 3 messages for this trip, which is what establishes that a log existed and is now absent. POL-NS-04 is the rider's exoneration route and its limbs (a) and (b) cannot be run without the log; trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so there is no recorded voice call off which limb (b) could be met either. On these artifacts the rider's route to a full refund is unproved.

POL-NS-05 voids an arrival marker only where the marker can be matched to a GPS fix placing the driver more than 300 m from the pin, or travelling at 15 km/h or more. With the trace MISSING at weight 0.0 there is no fix to match the 17:47:05 marker against, so no false-arrival finding is open and no recomputed waiting clock displaces the record's own wait of 6.6 minutes.

POL-NS-06 refunds the fee only on a measured effective in-geofence dwell shorter than the 300-second TRANSPORT_HUB minimum, and its limb (i) - the only route to summing separate in-geofence intervals - requires a populated traffic advisory whose geometry covers the pickup road. No dwell was measured because the trace is MISSING at weight 0.0, and the advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-00213-01 is itself MISSING at weight 0.0, so limb (i) is unavailable and no shortfall can be shown.

POL-NS-03's wrong-entrance route is expressly decided 'from coordinates alone' - whether the driver was stationary outside the arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin - and with the trace MISSING there are no coordinates to run it on. The venue_id on the pickup pin is a corroborating field, not a substitute for the 400 m distance test, so the clause cannot be reached on this bundle.

The fare_breakdown is complete and unimpaired. The SGD 6.00 cancellation fee is the greater of the TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee of SGD 6.00 and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee of SGD 4.00, which is exactly what fee_schedule.resolution_rule requires. The itemised line therefore reconciles, POL-NS-08 limb (d) is not engaged, and nothing down-weights the amount in dispute.

POL-NS-07's anti-farming check requires BOTH limbs. The driver profile shows no_show_terminations_30d of 3, below the count threshold of 4, against completed_trips_30d of 107 - a rate of 2.8 percent, below the 0.08 threshold. Neither limb trips, so compensation is not withheld and the escalation branch of that clause is not engaged.

Where POL-NS-01 is satisfied and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's compensation at 80 percent of the SGD 6.00 fee, that is SGD 4.80, with the residual 20 percent retained as the platform service fee. Every displacing clause in that range depends on the missing trace or the missing chat log and none of them can be run, so nothing displaces the payout.

The driver's counterparty statement places him at the Jurong East bay from about 17:47 to 17:53 and says he replied to every message the rider sent. It is consistent with the complete trip_record's arrival event, its RIDER_UNREACHABLE termination and its 6.6-minute wait, and on a record where the two artifacts that could test that account are both absent, no admissible artifact contradicts it.

POL-GEN-01 confines the profile fields that may ground a finding. POL-NS-09 limb (d) reads rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d, which is 2 here and therefore below that limb's threshold of 3. The rider's prior_no_show_flags of 1 is a lifetime counter, is NOT the field limb (d) reads, and may not be substituted for it. No escalation on that ground.

The fee is presently PENDING with refund_issued_sgd of 0.00 - held, neither collected nor refunded. Under POL-GEN-03 NO_ACTION is party-relative and leaves fare_breakdown.payment_status and refund_issued_sgd exactly as they stand; it never creates a refund. On this rider-filed dispute the rider therefore takes nothing from a no-action disposition.

If the arrival finding cannot be made because the trace is MISSING at weight 0.0 alongside the MISSING chat log, the record does not settle the question and the honest disposition is escalation, not refund. POL-NS-09 holds the disputed fee rather than collecting or refunding it and POL-GEN-03 makes ESCALATE terminal and a replacement for any monetary outcome, so an escalation preserves the SGD 6.00 rather than moving it to the rider. The platform's own missing artifacts must not be converted into a cash refund out of a driver who recorded an arrival, a five-minute-plus hold and a RIDER_UNREACHABLE termination.

To the rider and to the driver — this dispute goes to a human reviewer, and the SGD 6.00 cancellation fee stays on hold (neither collected nor refunded) until that review is done.

The controlling reason is that you two have been here before. The platform's records show 2 no-show disputes between this rider (RDR-07690) and this driver (DRV-04355) in the trailing 90 days: rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 2 and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 2. POL-NS-09(c) makes 2 or more no-show disputes between the same rider and driver an automatic escalation, because a pattern like this cannot fairly be judged one case at a time. That ground alone sends the case to review.

The second reason is that the evidence that would settle the fee is missing. POL-NS-01 allows the fee only if all four of its conditions hold, and only limb (a) is on the record: the trip record shows an 'arrived' event at 2026-08-11T17:47:05 (limb a), and the driver ended the trip at 17:53:40 under RIDER_UNREACHABLE, one of the three codes limb (d) accepts. But limb (b) — a GPS fix inside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB pickup geofence at or before that tap — and limb (c) — a continuous 300-second in-geofence dwell measured from the first qualifying GPS fix and not from the tap — both read the GPS trace, and EV-GPS-00213 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT). The chat log EV-CHAT-00213 is also MISSING (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT). Limbs (b) and (c) are therefore UNDECIDED rather than failed, so the fee cannot be confirmed under POL-NS-01; and the rider's refund route under POL-NS-02 cannot be run either, because that clause needs a trace that actually contains no qualifying in-radius fix, and there is no trace to read.

For the driver: the 6.6-minute wait_time_min, and the 395 seconds between the 17:47:05 tap and the 17:53:40 cancellation, are the record's own timeline. POL-NS-01(c) expressly refuses to measure the required dwell from the 'arrived' tap, so those figures cannot establish limb (c). The claim for SGD 4.80 of driver compensation under POL-NS-07 fails on its own precondition, because that clause pays only 'where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full', and limbs (b) and (c) are not. The anti-farming check does not trip — 3 no-show terminations is below the threshold of 4, and 3 of 107 completed trips is 2.8%, below 8% — and the SGD 6.00 fare reconciles: it is the greater of the SGD 6.00 TRANSPORT_HUB zone fee and the SGD 4.00 RYDE_X tier fee, so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged. Your statement that you were at the bay from about 17:47 to 17:53 and answered every message is consistent with the trip record, but it is your own account, and no clause makes a party statement the test for limbs (b) or (c), so it cannot stand in for the missing trace.

For the rider: your unanswered-message route under POL-NS-04 cannot be run, because its limbs (a) and (b) both read the chat log and the log is gone; trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so there is no recorded call to meet limb (b) either. Your rider-presence limb is undecidable for the same reason. And the missing trace is not a refund: a MISSING artifact carries no fact, so it is not a trace showing the driver was elsewhere — it is simply the absence of the evidence that would prove either position.

For completeness: no escalation is taken from rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d, which is 2 and below that limb's threshold of 3, and prior_no_show_flags is a lifetime counter that the rule does not read. NO_ACTION is not the outcome, because the escalation grounds replace any monetary disposition.

The open question for the reviewer is whether the driver in fact entered and held the Jurong East pickup geofence for the required 300 seconds on 2026-08-11. If the driver-device trace and the chat log can be recovered and the four POL-NS-01 conditions then hold, the SGD 6.00 fee stands and the driver is compensated SGD 4.80; if limb (b) or limb (c) fails, the SGD 6.00 is refunded to the rider. Confidence 0.85: the escalation rests on the rider and driver profiles, each at full weight 1.0.

Escalation is not a win for either party; it is what the policy requires when the record cannot decide the question, and it is terminal, so no money order issues.

The charge cannot be upheld under POL-NS-01. A no-show fee is chargeable only if all four conditions hold, and the driver side must carry every one. Two are met on the trip record: the driver 'arrived' event at 17:47:05 (limb (a)), and the termination at 17:53:40 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_UNREACHABLE, one of the three codes limb (d) recognises — the driver did not select DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE. But limbs (b) and (c) depend on the GPS trace. EV-GPS-00213 is MISSING (weight_multiplier 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), so nothing places the driver inside the 150 m Jurong East geofence, and limb (c) measures the 300-second TRANSPORT_HUB dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not from the driver's 'arrived' tap. The trip record's own 6.6-minute wait and its 395-second arrival-to-cancellation interval are the record's timeline, but the arrival marker is a status the driver set and cannot itself establish the dwell. The driver's statement that he held the bay from about 17:47 to 17:53 is his own account and does not carry the positional facts the clause requires.

The fee is not refunded either. Each refund route needs a reading the bundle does not contain. POL-NS-02 refunds only where the trace holds no qualifying in-radius fix — a missing trace is not a trace, and under POL-GEN-02(3) a MISSING artifact carries no fact, so the absence cannot be read as the driver being elsewhere. POL-NS-05 (false arrival marker) needs a fix to test the 17:47:05 marker against, and POL-NS-06 (short dwell) needs a measured dwell; neither can run. The rider's own exoneration route, POL-NS-04, cannot run either: EV-CHAT-00213 is MISSING (weight 0.0) even though trip_record.chat_message_count of 3 shows a log existed and is now gone, so limbs (a) and (b) are undecided and the driver's assertion that he replied to every message cannot be tested against anything. POL-NS-03's wrong-entrance test is decided from coordinates alone and there are none, and its 400 m ceiling cannot be reached on a bundle with no coordinates. Every one of these limbs is undecided rather than failed, and an undecided limb supports neither the charge nor a refund.

The escalation is mandatory on its own terms. POL-NS-09(c) requires escalation where both profiles together show two or more no-show disputes between this same rider and this same driver in the trailing 90 days. EV-RPROF-00213 and EV-DPROF-00213 both record disputes_with_counterparty_90d = 2 — this is the third round between this pair — so the trigger is met, and the admissibility notes identify (c), not the POL-NS-07 anti-farming limb, as the live trigger. Independently, POL-NS-09(e) applies: the only artifact that could carry the deciding fact, the GPS trace, is impaired under POL-NS-08(b) (fewer than six fixes across the waiting window — here none at all).

Other points, for completeness. The SGD 6.00 fee reconciles: it is the greater of the TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00), which is what fee_schedule.resolution_rule prescribes, so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged and the amount is not discounted. POL-NS-07 compensation to the driver (80 percent of SGD 6.00 = SGD 4.80) requires POL-NS-01 satisfied in full; it is not, so no compensation is payable and no driver payment is funded out of this fee. The anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d of 3 against a threshold of 4, and 3/107 = 2.8 percent against 8 percent), so it neither withholds compensation nor adds an instruction to the escalation packet. rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 2, below the threshold of 3, and prior_no_show_flags is a lifetime counter that may not be substituted for it (POL-GEN-01).

Open question for the reviewer: obtain or reconstruct EV-GPS-00213 and EV-CHAT-00213, or the device-level data behind them, so it can be settled whether the driver was inside the Jurong East geofence for a continuous 300 seconds, and whether the rider's three messages went unanswered for 120 seconds. Those are the two tests the missing artifacts were meant to decide.

The only GPS artifact on the brief, EV-GPS-00213, is MISSING: it has no payload and a weight_multiplier of 0.0, and a MISSING artifact can carry no fact at all, although its absence is itself citable (POL-GEN-02). WHY THE FEE CANNOT BE DECIDED ON THIS FILE. The fee is chargeable only if all four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold. Two of them are met on the complete trip record EV-TRIP-00213 (weight 1.0): limb (a), the arrival event at 17:47:05, and limb (d), the RIDER_UNREACHABLE termination at 17:53:40. Limbs (b) and (c) both depend on the GPS trace EV-GPS-00213, and that artifact is MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT. Limb (b) needs a fix inside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius; limb (c) needs a continuous 300-second in-geofence dwell measured from the first qualifying GPS fix and expressly not from the 'arrived' tap. Under POL-GEN-02 a missing artifact carries no fact, and an absent reading does not make a limb fail; it leaves the limb undecided. An undecided limb supports neither a charge that needs the clause to hold nor a refund that needs it to fail. The driver's argument that the trip record's own 395-second interval (17:47:05 to 17:53:40, wait_time_min 6.6) supplies the dwell is not accepted: POL-NS-01(c) fixes the start of that clock at the first qualifying in-geofence fix, so the record's timeline cannot stand in for the missing measurement.

THE RIDER'S REFUND ROUTES ALSO FAIL. POL-NS-02 refunds only where the trace contains no qualifying in-radius fix; there is no trace at all, so its absence proves nothing about where the driver was, which is what the driver's own submission correctly says. POL-NS-04's limbs (a) and (b) need the chat log, and EV-CHAT-00213 is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, even though trip_record.chat_message_count records 3 messages; the rider's coordination route therefore cannot be run either way. POL-NS-05 needs a fix to match the 17:47:05 marker and there is none. POL-NS-06 needs a measured dwell and there is none. POL-NS-03 needs coordinates and there are none. So the rider does not win, and the driver does not win.

THE DRIVER'S COMPENSATION ALSO FAILS. POL-NS-07 pays 80 percent of SGD 6.00, that is SGD 4.80, only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full. It is not satisfied, so there is no verified no-show to compensate. The anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d 3, below the count limb of 4, and 3/107 = 2.8 percent, below the 0.08 rate limb), and no escalation arises on that branch. The driver's counterparty statement (projected hold from about 17:47 to 17:53) is consistent with the arrival and termination events on the trip record, but a party's own account cannot supply the missing geofence reading. The fare line itself is clean: SGD 6.00 is the greater of the TRANSPORT_HUB zone fee of SGD 6.00 and the RYDE_X tier fee of SGD 4.00, exactly as fee_schedule.resolution_rule requires, so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged and nothing down-weights the amount in dispute.

WHY THIS ESCALATES. POL-NS-09(c) is met on its own terms: rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 2, showing two or more no-show disputes between this same rider and driver in the trailing 90 days. Escalation is mandatory on that ground whatever else the file shows. The separate no_show_disputes_30d limb is not the trigger and the rider's lifetime prior_no_show_flags is context only and is not substituted for it.

THE OPEN QUESTIONS FOR THE REVIEWER. First, can the driver-device trace and the chat export for TRP-00213 be recovered from the telemetry pipeline, given the trip record shows 3 messages were exchanged. Second, if the trace is recovered, did the driver enter the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius at or before 17:47:05 and hold position there for 300 continuous seconds. Third, if the chat is recovered, did the rider send a locating or coordinating message during the waiting window and did the driver answer within 120 seconds or place an in-app call recorded in trip_record.in_app_calls.

CONFIDENCE. 0.0, capped by the missing GPS trace at weight_multiplier 0.0, the artifact that would carry the deciding fact. That is below the loaded policy's 0.70 escalation floor.

The same complete trip_record shows the driver terminated the trip at 2026-08-11T17:53:40+08:00 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_UNREACHABLE, which is one of the three codes POL-NS-01 limb (d) recognises. The driver did not select DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, the code that clause treats as the driver's own admission that he could not find the rider.

On the trip_record's own clock the driver was on station from the 17:47:05 arrival event to the 17:53:40 cancellation, an elapsed 395 seconds, and the record's own wait_time_min of 6.6 corroborates it. That is longer than the 300-second minimum dwell the fee schedule fixes for a TRANSPORT_HUB pickup under POL-NS-01 limb (c). Limb (c) prefers to measure that dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, and no trace exists to supply one; the record's own timeline is the only timeline in the bundle, and nothing in it shows a shorter hold.

The GPS trace EV-GPS-00213 is MISSING - weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT - and the admissibility note on the artifact itself records that POL-NS-01 limbs (b) and (c), POL-NS-02, POL-NS-03, POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06 are all undecidable for want of any positional data. Under POL-GEN-02(3) a MISSING artifact carries no fact, so the absence of a trace is not a trace showing the driver elsewhere. POL-NS-02's refund test requires a trace that actually 'contains no qualifying in-radius fix', and there is no such trace here to examine.

The chat log EV-CHAT-00213 is MISSING - weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT - although trip_record.chat_message_count records 3 messages for this trip, which is what establishes that a log existed and is now absent. POL-NS-04 is the rider's exoneration route and its limbs (a) and (b) cannot be run without the log; trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so there is no recorded voice call off which limb (b) could be met either. On these artifacts the rider's route to a full refund is unproved.

POL-NS-05 voids an arrival marker only where the marker can be matched to a GPS fix placing the driver more than 300 m from the pin, or travelling at 15 km/h or more. With the trace MISSING at weight 0.0 there is no fix to match the 17:47:05 marker against, so no false-arrival finding is open and no recomputed waiting clock displaces the record's own wait of 6.6 minutes.

ledger.claim: POL-NS-06 refunds the fee only on a measured effective in-geofence dwell shorter than the 300-second TRANSPORT_HUB minimum, and its limb (i) - the only route to summing separate in-geofence intervals - requires a populated traffic advisory whose geometry covers the pickup road. No dwell was measured because the trace is MISSING at weight 0.0, and the advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-00213-01 is itself MISSING at weight 0.0, so limb (i) is unavailable and no shortfall can be shown.

ledger.claim: The fare_breakdown is complete and unimpaired. The SGD 6.00 cancellation fee is the greater of the TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee of SGD 6.00 and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee of SGD 4.00, which is exactly what fee_schedule.resolution_rule requires. The itemised line therefore reconciles, POL-NS-08 limb (d) is not engaged, and nothing down-weights the amount in dispute.

POL-NS-07's anti-farming check requires BOTH limbs. The driver profile shows no_show_terminations_30d of 3, below the count threshold of 4, against completed_trips_30d of 107 - a rate of 2.8 percent, below the 0.08 threshold. Neither limb trips, so compensation is not withheld and the escalation branch of that clause is not engaged.

Where POL-NS-01 is satisfied and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's compensation at 80 percent of the SGD 6.00 fee, that is SGD 4.80, with the residual 20 percent retained as the platform service fee. Every displacing clause in that range depends on the missing trace or the missing chat log and none of them can be run, so nothing displaces the payout.

The driver's counterparty statement places him at the Jurong East bay from about 17:47 to 17:53 and says he replied to every message the rider sent. It is consistent with the complete trip_record's arrival event, its RIDER_UNREACHABLE termination and its 6.6-minute wait, and on a record where the two artifacts that could test that account are both absent, no admissible artifact contradicts it.

POL-GEN-01 confines the profile fields that may ground a finding. POL-NS-09 limb (d) reads rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d, which is 2 here and therefore below that limb's threshold of 3. The rider's prior_no_show_flags of 1 is a lifetime counter, is NOT the field limb (d) reads, and may not be substituted for it. No escalation on that ground.

ledger.claim: The fee is presently PENDING with refund_issued_sgd of 0.00 - held, neither collected nor refunded. Under POL-GEN-03 NO_ACTION is party-relative and leaves fare_breakdown.payment_status and refund_issued_sgd exactly as they stand; it never creates a refund. On this rider-filed dispute the rider therefore takes nothing from a no-action disposition.

If the arrival finding cannot be made because the trace is MISSING at weight 0.0 alongside the MISSING chat log, the record does not settle the question and the honest disposition is escalation, not refund. POL-NS-09 holds the disputed fee rather than collecting or refunding it and POL-GEN-03 makes ESCALATE terminal and a replacement for any monetary outcome, so an escalation preserves the SGD 6.00 rather than moving it to the rider. The platform's own missing artifacts must not be converted into a cash refund out of a driver who recorded an arrival, a five-minute-plus hold and a RIDER_UNREACHABLE termination.
